text:
Glycolysis makes 4 ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation (2 at phosphoglycerate kinase, 2 at pyruvate kinase) and spends 2 at hexokinase and phosphofructokinase-1, so the net yield is **2 ATP per glucose**. The team note gets the spacing right but the values wrong: glycogen entry saves one ATP, so glycogen nets 3 ATP, and glucose nets 2, not 3 and 4.

CONFIDENCE: 97
